column1: # Case corpus for the smbc model parser.  One row per case.
# model           models/<model>.txt -- fed to nunchaku as smbc's stdout
# problem         problems/<problem>.nun -- the problem nunchaku is asked
# deadline        wall-clock ceiling in seconds for the whole run, or "-"
# expectation     one word, spelled out in README.md
# Golden output files are NOT part of this commit: the shared driver
# (regress/support/run_case) lands separately and the expectations are
# generated once every code change in this release has landed.
